description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Booz Allen Hamilton is hiring a full stack software engineer to develop production-ready software and systems from vision through production. The role focuses on building end-to-end solutions, improving systems, and helping clients address challenges while accounting for current architecture and future enhancements.
Software Engineer developing full-stack solutions, identifying system improvements, and considering current architecture and future enhancements

Responsibilities:
• As a full stack developer, you can resolve a problem with a complete end-to-end solution in a fast, agile environment
• As a full stack developer at Booz Allen, you’ll use your passion to learn new tools and techniques and identify needed system improvements
• You’ll help clients overcome their most difficult challenges using the latest architectural approaches, tools, and technologies
• You’ll help make sure the solution developed by the team considers the current architecture and operating environment, as well as future functionality and enhancements

Requirements:
• Experience with developing production-ready web applications
• Experience with React, JavaScript, TypeScript, and modern front-end tooling
• Experience with building responsive, maintainable UI components and modular application architectures
• Experience with using Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and Agile development processes
• Knowledge of REST APIs
• Ability to translate mission needs and user workflows into effective front-end solutions
• Secret clearance
• HS diploma or GED

Preferred:
• Experience with deploying applications in Palantir Foundry
• Experience with containerization
• Knowledge of UI and UX best practices
